Joins Montgomery tracts with 2026 code violation counts and CDC high blood pressure prevalence, computes violations per 1,000 total population, and returns the paired tract set with the overall correlation and paired tract count.
sql:
WITH code AS (
  SELECT geoid, CAST(n AS DOUBLE) AS code_violations_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261025_7e1f0f' AND source = 'm1_city' AND grp = 'all'
),
health AS (
  SELECT tractfips AS geoid,
         CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation,
         CAST(bphigh_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS high_blood_pressure_prevalence
  FROM session.fw_7e1f0f_m2_cdc
),
base AS (
  SELECT t.geoid, t.name,
         COALESCE(c.code_violations_count, 0) AS code_violations_count,
         h.totalpopulation,
         h.high_blood_pressure_prevalence
  FROM fw_pg.tracts t
  LEFT JOIN code c ON t.geoid = c.geoid
  LEFT JOIN health h ON t.geoid = h.geoid
  WHERE t.geoid IS NOT NULL
),
paired AS (
  SELECT geoid, name, code_violations_count, totalpopulation, high_blood_pressure_prevalence,
         code_violations_count / totalpopulation * 1000 AS code_violations_per_1000_totalpopulation
  FROM base
  WHERE code_violations_count IS NOT NULL
    AND totalpopulation IS NOT NULL
    AND high_blood_pressure_prevalence IS NOT NULL
    AND totalpopulation > 0
)
SELECT
  name,
  code_violations_per_1000_totalpopulation,
  high_blood_pressure_prevalence,
  code_violations_count,
  totalpopulation,
  CORR(code_violations_per_1000_totalpopulation, high_blood_pressure_prevalence) OVER () AS correlation,
  COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts,
  geoid
FROM paired
ORDER BY code_violations_per_1000_totalpopulation DESC NULLS LAST, name ASC
LIMIT 200
